proposals.head: cbfc74490dc2cd92ee21653533b8fcff0404a927
proposals.title: Read the PF enable reference back on every pass with loaded rules
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fresh PF enable-reference readiness
proposals.evidence: Main no-op pass never checks saved token; independent baseline test observes0 readbacks. Candidate reads reference+enabled and withholds readiness on missing/error without implicit acquisition.

proposals.head: 56db89886d0daf2d6a535e640c286772b58f0256
proposals.title: Do not treat a pass that wrote nothing as an interrupted write
proposals.requirement_mapping: Crash/no-op resilience without forgetting failed writes
proposals.evidence: Independent baseline replay of no-op durable states retires working rules; candidate exact-first-journal exemption plus failed-phase preservation covers candidate writes, no silent acknowledgement.

proposals.head: 1f1666e8c4b37b428cec3a48c626cd1518ef5804
proposals.title: Report the guest's hardware address in the runtime observation
proposals.requirement_mapping: Observe exact native guest MAC for independent identity/neighbor checks.
proposals.evidence: Baseline: 23 failed, 1 passed; the old observer drops a present native MAC. Candidate observer rejects malformed/conflicting MAC rows and emits the native address.

proposals.head: a70e9a2d383c188002b8b41c1b73d6f8a26b4468
proposals.title: Refuse root-owned identifiers the root owner cannot store
proposals.requirement_mapping: Root store identifier grammar
proposals.evidence: Independent baseline four64-character root-profile tests all incorrectly accept; candidate rejects before persistence while nonroot64-character IDs remain representable.

proposals.head: 99c47468b725fde60ca56e65fd7fdc80dc034701
proposals.title: Refuse socket publications in workload recipes
proposals.requirement_mapping: Do not provision destructive or unmodeled Socketainer/socket-backed definitions; preserve current publication topology.
proposals.evidence: Baseline: 4 failed, 2 passed. Recipe parser formerly accepted --publish-socket despite lacking corresponding publication verification; candidate refuses it before mutation.

proposals.head: 3bdfc6f5701604623a501d9a181e0a0b854d8c95
proposals.title: Allow only vendor-defined options in workload recipes
proposals.requirement_mapping: Use the installed Apple Container CLI grammar, not Linux Docker-shaped options.
proposals.evidence: Baseline: 11 failed, 1 passed. Vendor source and parser counterexamples confirm --sysctl/--init compatibility gaps; candidate closes allowlist and updates modeled kernel args.

proposals.head: 620962f6b811895b672707957f8c9680006dea7b
proposals.title: Report unfamiliar native rows as unknown and keep lookups redacted
proposals.requirement_mapping: Unknown/malformed evidence never becomes stopped or authorizes recovery; diagnostics must not expose native credentials.
proposals.evidence: Baseline: 32 failed, 6 passed. Closed state/shape validation and redacted native lookups reject malformed JSON and CLI output.

proposals.head: 42e31d058da095e515a3509d85b21bc30da06dda
proposals.title: Let an enrollment tolerate a named peer definition while stopped
proposals.requirement_mapping: Retain the stopped NPM test definition without authorizing a concurrent writer of the production bind.
proposals.evidence: Baseline: 14 failed, 18 passed confirms original missing exception. Independent candidate counterexample: two tests failed because a retained peer marked stopped by reset API was ignored while its runtime job was still loaded. Supplement requires actual fixed-label service-manager absence in both account domains before ignoring a conflicting writable peer.

proposals.head: 6ddc99f257f285db9de57e74fd36b1ead396fb53
proposals.title: Let a failed rollback be repeated and keep it off other journals
proposals.requirement_mapping: Explicit repeatable rollback and holder preservation
proposals.evidence: Independent baseline interrupted rollback fails in both scopes; original fix supports retry but candidate completion trusted stale receipt. Six fresh drift regressions fail before supplemental fe1d750 and pass after.

proposals.head: e9a2ff53ae2f4c4cc4f271cb2cfd30b27cf51a81
proposals.title: Add an optional repeat interval to the Monit recovery rule
proposals.requirement_mapping: Single Monit recovery owner and repeated proven-stopped recovery
proposals.evidence: Schema/renderer adds bounded optional repeat clause only to reserved42 recovery action. Default bytes preserved; runtime uncertainty never becomes42 through this change. Actual complete legacy Monit rendering still requires conformance.

proposals.head: 03ad4eaacbe0c636059411fa7ac6d0006cc6ef58
proposals.title: Let the discovery scanner's pass interval be set up to 120 seconds
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits a 20-second scanner rest while preserving independent fast publisher expiry. Static half-lease check is no measured scan-time guarantee.
proposals.evidence: Fits a 20-second scanner rest while preserving independent fast publisher expiry. Static half-lease check is no measured scan-time guarantee.

proposals.head: 0820a7238b5d4f5cb064882812b090ff0336fcdf
proposals.title: Make an interrupted installation recoverable
proposals.requirement_mapping: Interrupted installs and exclusive operation holds
proposals.evidence: Independent baseline KeyboardInterrupt leaves no failed_phase; candidate handles all open phases, exact digest recovery and interruption after release without automatic rollback.

proposals.head: 85216c54741a0cf7260bb84eb57b17b95ceb8f37
proposals.title: Wait a bounded time for a busy owner lock instead of failing
proposals.requirement_mapping: Busy lock is not missing admission or permission to bypass lock
proposals.evidence: Five-second wait budget retries only exit75; fixed owner command prefix and no launchctl/Monit retry. Existing persistent inode retained. Deadline bounds wait not arbitrary kernel-blocked calls; native timing unverified.

proposals.head: 157b775fe377c51320ffabee1f3914fd06ad33f4
proposals.title: Read lower-case assignment keys and decimal text for integer fields
proposals.requirement_mapping: Data-only legacy import
proposals.evidence: Lowercase literal keys and origin-limited decimal conversion are useful; typed JSON/TOML/plist strings remain unconverted, substitutions remain refused. One-author conflict check intentionally precedes later conversion. Prior blanket lowercase refusal was a limitation, not required safety.

proposals.head: f85fc7984c9a678c167497ba4bfe8894bf277a86
proposals.title: Make every check in the PF backend script explicit
proposals.requirement_mapping: Narrow script mutation boundary on system Bash
proposals.evidence: Independent system-Bash/fake-PF experiment: original backend accepts drain0.0.0.0/0, exits0, issues two global-range fake kills; candidate exits64 with zero calls. Strict checked assignments prevent failed empty reads becoming proof. No actual PF invoked.

proposals.head: b975cc717b4c7bc3eafccc4db3652764c2a461b8
proposals.title: Report shared-space, IPv6 and hardware addresses in the public guard
proposals.requirement_mapping: Public/private data boundary
proposals.evidence: Address and hardware detection expanded without host-specific values. Generic locally-administered MAC exclusion is explicitly limited; known private values remain necessary.

proposals.head: 937ce4432db4b21b403fc97645610ae4d7b4bf0f
proposals.title: Let preflight print the evidence document that --evidence reads
proposals.requirement_mapping: Reusable read-only observations
proposals.evidence: Collected evidence round-trips through strict parser; ordinary report is not an evidence file, timestamps remain bounded.

proposals.head: d148912102e1ba6aca38236120b0f75f65fc1fb7
proposals.title: Correct the read-only guides where they contradict the code
proposals.requirement_mapping: Truthful read-only workflow
proposals.evidence: Checked docs against workflow_gate, entrypoints and two examples. Mutation remains refused, and reports make no active platform claim.

proposals.head: e15903f6637237263a4ee6fc55f12268fae5d3a4
proposals.title: Keep a retired policy id and one bulky candidate from stopping others
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits policy isolation: retired private request identifiers cannot authorize records; a bulky candidate loses only its own policy. Corrupt envelope remains a global failure.
proposals.evidence: Fits policy isolation: retired private request identifiers cannot authorize records; a bulky candidate loses only its own policy. Corrupt envelope remains a global failure.

proposals.head: 4092bcd0b8aebfe309dbfda58e735f2f43f7b255
proposals.title: Renew one expired registration without withdrawing its policy
proposals.requirement_mapping: Amend: retain per-record clean native-timer replacement, reject the proposal to claim present/verified while every current registration is unconfirmed. Final pipe output and foreign-interface checks also repaired.
proposals.evidence: Amend: retain per-record clean native-timer replacement, reject the proposal to claim present/verified while every current registration is unconfirmed. Final pipe output and foreign-interface checks also repaired.

proposals.head: 2dc428d205ee3a6932cb879dd26a17476b92e2cf
proposals.title: Prove the recovery sequence and five other runtime properties
proposals.requirement_mapping: Prove recovery needs two fresh stopped observations, current admission and single-writer safety.
proposals.evidence: All 31 newly supplied tests already pass baseline main, consistent with tests-only proof addition. Tests inspect call sequence and failed starts; source review found no production mutation in mock tier.

proposals.head: 61201f59c80fb010cdcf6fa00cc09a62d3385a33
proposals.title: Refuse owner settings whose own import can never import
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits actual Apple-model anchoring: an import without _airplay._tcp cannot select devices and must be refused by this owner.
proposals.evidence: Fits actual Apple-model anchoring: an import without _airplay._tcp cannot select devices and must be refused by this owner.

proposals.head: f0cd1bd762d819f8b070b791978f2532fd39766b
proposals.title: Refuse a retained release before the hold and the journal
proposals.requirement_mapping: No extra outage for already retained immutable release
proposals.evidence: Independent baseline retained-release replay changes journal/hold on refusal; candidate refuses before either. Existing record and loaded jobs stay unchanged.

proposals.head: 307190d61cf0c650e2b1d4b243af7e2cba5a0391
proposals.title: Create every directory of a bundle and a release with mode 0700
proposals.requirement_mapping: Private installation artifacts under every umask
proposals.evidence: Independent baseline test creates intermediate0755 directories under022. Candidate creates each directory0700 without recursive permission changes.

proposals.head: 4caed302342d9812d78b96870c403dbccfacc0f1
proposals.title: Give an unknown identifier the closed diagnostic, not a traceback
proposals.requirement_mapping: Redacted diagnostics
proposals.evidence: Unknown lookup identifiers are closed JSON errors; baseline traceback reproduced by selected tests.

proposals.head: 8b7416c07f45e0fdb65ccdcd90cf8502b8f2520b
proposals.title: Refuse compound password keys and passphrases in the importer
proposals.requirement_mapping: Credential exclusion
proposals.evidence: Compound password names and passphrases are refused at selector and nested projection boundaries; arbitrary mislabeled secrets remain outside guarantee.

proposals.head: 0fc94998404c12e855cdc85bba022e9f4164c4d8
proposals.title: Refuse a second mapping to one destination whatever it yields
proposals.requirement_mapping: One setting author
proposals.evidence: Null, missing and nested mapping conflicts are rejected structurally before file projection; baseline counterexamples reproduced.

proposals.head: de6642556183cbcbcca33251658cc49a671d6a34
proposals.title: Read PF state rows in the forms the macOS state model prints
proposals.requirement_mapping: Darwin PF translated states and exact address parsing
proposals.evidence: Independent three-endpoint sanitized row is refused by main, accepted with all three addresses by candidate. Shapes from legacy fixture/printer lineage are not raw-capture evidence; fe1d750 corrects misleading test header.

proposals.head: 882a6efca1c6a01ea6b3b00a30810e08b9f8540e
proposals.title: Refuse live addresses before a full stop and routed IPv6 in instances
proposals.requirement_mapping: No desired runtime addresses
proposals.evidence: Sentence-final IPv4 and routed IPv6 are rejected; free prose is not executed. Baseline accepts the documented counterexamples.

proposals.head: d6ae89c2f73edadad60a062cbd4d58dfba699aba
proposals.title: Refuse a second LAN alias row for one workload
proposals.requirement_mapping: One LAN alias per workload
proposals.evidence: Duplicate alias supplies no independent setting and is refused; baseline counterexample reproduced.

proposals.head: 9a9e0ae6061e34878c2dbb7b6572a56d46fcaded
proposals.title: Rename the status fulfilled-unverified to unverified
proposals.requirement_mapping: Evidence vocabulary
proposals.evidence: No proof becomes unverified rather than fulfilled-unverified. Changed output vocabulary is version2, preflight/validate remainversion1.

proposals.head: d0a19df245fcc022b9dec249f1392138789b3c1e
proposals.title: Make the passing result of check reachable for a listed platform
proposals.requirement_mapping: Qualification gate
proposals.evidence: Positive check path requires shipped platform listing plus correct retained evidence; test-only listing does not alter empty production matrix.

proposals.head: de261086e31449a3f39ad50e9f2c9df7b4ec1cb1
proposals.title: Compare projected URL hosts by DNS case
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits DNS ASCII case equivalence and existing HA endpoint URL projection. External and credentials-bearing URLs remain unchanged.
proposals.evidence: Fits DNS ASCII case equivalence and existing HA endpoint URL projection. External and credentials-bearing URLs remain unchanged.

proposals.head: 8134743e010daff61b0f9e762485adc7fe29aba2
proposals.title: Find instance names in capitals and as a label of a dotted name
proposals.requirement_mapping: Private identifiers
proposals.evidence: Case and dotted-label variants are detected without widening unrelated port matching. Synthetic matching tests passed.

proposals.head: 18ef0a0d61250d7cc88a73211d19810b6813d3ed
proposals.title: Correct the guide's reader sentence and two smaller statements
proposals.requirement_mapping: Accurate protection claims
proposals.evidence: Documentation distinguishes static general readers from protected owner state; subsequent #93 extends protected runtime reads.

proposals.head: 200aa8846a1f6b8debddb78d511eb267d5fe6189
proposals.title: Add declared baseline names to the per-instance guard
proposals.requirement_mapping: Private native owner names
proposals.evidence: Declared VPN/proxy/extension names join known private literal inventory; generic heuristics alone are not enough.

proposals.head: d7a6bd83372d327d5e0fc8615b0ebf2456322678
proposals.title: Let a deployment job choose the Standard launchd process type
proposals.requirement_mapping: Preserve existing Standard process type where explicitly declared
proposals.evidence: Current recovery template uses Standard; candidate can express that without changing default Background. This alone does not preserve current throttle30 because renderer still fixes10.

proposals.head: 58354fb1ae8779673bffd46962dc177d923cbb2a
proposals.title: Wait for launchd to remove a job before loading it again
proposals.requirement_mapping: Avoid immediate bootout/bootstrap race
proposals.evidence: Bounded wait reads exact target label and only3/113 prove absence; no foreign mutation. Post-timeout bootstrap retains normal error path. Live asynchronous bootout behavior remains unverified.

proposals.head: accb7c1f7b229e72b103f8fe1c3a453128522057
proposals.title: Let one discovery selection state its own miss tolerance
proposals.requirement_mapping: Needed to express differing outward (three passes) and inward (immediate) loss policy without duplicating owner logic.
proposals.evidence: Needed to express differing outward (three passes) and inward (immediate) loss policy without duplicating owner logic.

proposals.head: fcf9f96bacb793dbdcd2d753c37d35f06ed47218
proposals.title: Let a discovery selection name its DNS-SD service types
proposals.requirement_mapping: Useful explicit narrowing/data representation, but no auto-tcp implementation. Existing dynamic outward enumeration is not fully replaced by an explicit list; keep extraction/conformance gap.
proposals.evidence: Useful explicit narrowing/data representation, but no auto-tcp implementation. Existing dynamic outward enumeration is not fully replaced by an explicit list; keep extraction/conformance gap.

proposals.head: ee267430065db09683043a1d18e3d4c2dd0d3a75
proposals.title: Let a discovery import say it does not depend on the return path
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits installed inward discovery independence from the separate audio-return owner. Discovery does not prove audio. Explicit policy digest and exact context still required.
proposals.evidence: Fits installed inward discovery independence from the separate audio-return owner. Discovery does not prove audio. Explicit policy digest and exact context still required.

proposals.head: eaf0fe7942d68c08a47efca6f7f92d535aac60ff
proposals.title: Let a workload contract state the facts of a real definition
proposals.requirement_mapping: Represent current workload resources, pinned images, privilege, named volumes and mounts as separate configuration data.
proposals.evidence: Inspected closed definition-fact schema and executable tests for resource/mount/port facts, explicit false/empty values and strict bounds; candidate suite passes.

proposals.head: d306a08ba990b92db967e720b3c0b9026eac4a6f
proposals.title: Let an instance describe a site supervisor's statuses and deadlines
proposals.requirement_mapping: Existing supervisor representation
proposals.evidence: Custom statuses/deadlines can be represented without granting retained supervisor unsupported capability. Ambiguous statuses are unmet, unsupported actions reported by gaps.

proposals.head: 17fce7c9d15f30d9ce5c9fbc75495688f6b63910
proposals.title: Let an instance name the tool that starts its workloads after a boot
proposals.requirement_mapping: One Monit/startup owner declares which tool starts the runtime and/or workload fleet; no second controller.
proposals.evidence: Baseline: 9 failed, 9 passed; prior schema rejected existing fleet-start ownership vocabulary. Candidate accepts owner declaration and produces unresolved gate where authority is not accepted.

proposals.head: 76c7d27efe2cb48c4b51d312361b8bd92e18a50c
proposals.title: Let an enrollment bind a volume identifier instead of a device number
proposals.requirement_mapping: Bind persistent data on external/APFS volumes across reboot without trusting a volatile st_dev.
proposals.evidence: Inspected Darwin volume UUID parsing, whole mount root binding, inode/path checks, malformed metadata refusals. Original combined suite includes hosted read-only volume grammar tests.

proposals.head: a7f935b84505f5c4aa1d1284ce41dac9cbe18463
proposals.title: Let the root owner keep a site's pinned packet-rule anchor
proposals.requirement_mapping: Preserve existing anchor identity and ordering
proposals.evidence: Existing installed anchor parses with candidate and main rejects a nonproduct pin. Drift refusal prevents claiming existing foreign rules; an actual owner handoff remains blocked by installed-source and protected-state gaps.

proposals.head: f13c572f64aa785be57702be373211d8985e661d
proposals.title: Let a host redirect declare an unrestricted source (source_scope)
proposals.requirement_mapping: NPM router-forwarded arbitrary client sources
proposals.evidence: Installed owner uses from-any for NPM; candidate allows only structural host destination with separately acknowledged content digest. DirectDNS also currently renders from-any but candidate correctly forbids guest-direct any-source, leaving declared narrowing/conformance gap.

proposals.head: 834069e06da64aa8fd6b22340d7d50a2f200816a
proposals.title: Read dns-sd diagnostics only where the client prints them
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits genuine record preservation: diagnostic-looking names/TXT are data, while actual native denial/failure grammar fails. Source-derived fixtures, not host captures.
proposals.evidence: Fits genuine record preservation: diagnostic-looking names/TXT are data, while actual native denial/failure grammar fails. Source-derived fixtures, not host captures.

proposals.head: b6b66624007c04ba2dbe596dc9e6d45f21cd6904
proposals.title: Leave out one unusable instance instead of failing its policy
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits healthy device isolation when another instance cannot supply usable records. Wrong interface, failed command, output/budget failures and wholly unproved scans still fail. Amended interaction with missed memory prevents republishing a rejected source.
proposals.evidence: Fits healthy device isolation when another instance cannot supply usable records. Wrong interface, failed command, output/budget failures and wholly unproved scans still fail. Amended interaction with missed memory prevents republishing a rejected source.

proposals.head: 77e6a5b7859b9d3cd5276de486590a7fc05652f7
proposals.title: Take the prefixes of projected host names from the policy
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits private prefix separation and loop exclusion. Does not preserve exact legacy hostname suffix algorithm/length; exact-name conformance remains unresolved.
proposals.evidence: Fits private prefix separation and loop exclusion. Does not preserve exact legacy hostname suffix algorithm/length; exact-name conformance remains unresolved.

proposals.head: 7b7f20c844002eb72adcd7bc5cd5c00dfe87e967
proposals.title: Let the scanner keep a missed record for a set number of passes
proposals.requirement_mapping: Fits outward completed-pass tolerance while preserving original sight time and independent lease expiry. Amended to discard exact rejected (name,type) identities from memory. Do not enable tolerance above one for the installed inward behavior.
proposals.evidence: Fits outward completed-pass tolerance while preserving original sight time and independent lease expiry. Amended to discard exact rejected (name,type) identities from memory. Do not enable tolerance above one for the installed inward behavior.

proposals.head: fe73e197a327beed235d53974e5d2736dc2ead27
proposals.title: Let an installation choose to take a lost PF enable reference again
proposals.requirement_mapping: Existing owner reacquires missing PF reference
proposals.evidence: Readable installed source acquire_reference reacquires on missing token. Candidate makes this explicit, digest-bound and requires fresh verified profiles, no holds/acknowledgement or kept-unknown paths. Default remains read-only verification.

proposals.head: a5954c3a1a8fd930d58198abca7808eff27751df
proposals.title: Make the PF owner's behaviour after a reboot an explicit choice
proposals.requirement_mapping: Restart after proven new kernel generation
proposals.evidence: Explicit self-heal drops old address records only with changed boot-session and empty owned anchor; no old guest invalidation. Stored failed acknowledgement remains owed. Mock/hosted UUID reads are not unattended reboot acceptance.

proposals.head: ae39adc8ec07bf307df966d29f8a05bef70cc20a
proposals.title: Defer one profile on an unmet precondition; count only own states
proposals.requirement_mapping: Independent NPM/DNS/HA failure domains and meaningful drain
proposals.evidence: Baseline one failed endpoint aborts entire owner. Candidate defers only affected profiles; successful kill plus retained matching states is distinct from unreadable/failed kill, which remains failed+ack. Narrow own-state matcher excludes outside flows and includes host-LAN peer. No proof of packet safety beyond mocked rows.

proposals.head: dcc92e347a0b8ae4831222a224fd781a37f43928
proposals.title: Hold one service without pausing the site
proposals.requirement_mapping: Stop one service without disabling all networking
proposals.evidence: Service-specific negative holds union with operator pause/root gates; wrong holder cannot release and unknown service damages intent. Preservation tested across owner/deployment while no unprivileged positive root authority added.

proposals.head: ea478a28c687ce3a8f68d578b94a6576980d67fe
proposals.title: Render literal owner inputs from the instance and search programs
proposals.requirement_mapping: Single-author conformance
proposals.evidence: Literal spans round-trip with preserved style. Clean lexical program inventory incorrectly allowed promotion despite hardcoded numeric settings. Independent proof requires supplemental refusal; rendering remains available. Supplemental regression preserves hardcoded program interval while changing rendered interval; automatic promotion now refuses inventory programs and search-only TOML.

proposals.head: fe8431cf193d77e232bb25a4bfa8483dade72f76
proposals.title: Document where the release pin comes from and what it proves
proposals.requirement_mapping: Reproducible artifacts
proposals.evidence: File hash/version checks are accurately described as pin verification, not proof of the running distribution. Revision is bound but not independently authenticated.

proposals.head: 050abd3f672728ba72a8c5f24a8b696acc727f7a
proposals.title: Let recovery give the vendor start call its own time bound
proposals.requirement_mapping: Long Apple Container start calls need an explicit finite budget independent of read deadlines.
proposals.evidence: Baseline: 11 failed, 14 passed. Candidate passes timeout to the one vendor start subprocess and leaves defaults stable.

proposals.head: 4a2741ceeaebbaa321fe81bcfa15411e8e59e339
proposals.title: Add hosted macOS contract tests for the local preflight collector
proposals.requirement_mapping: Real native parser contracts
proposals.evidence: Candidate local run had four failures: three no-instance LAN ambiguity, one real retired-plus-active extension parser gap. Correct native shape, keep schema/roundtrip on all Macs, constrain strict topology expectations to hosted CI. Sanitized native regression and direct saved read-only inventory both parse after correction.

proposals.head: e21370d0801e306e2eb5a9d0ed4b3f1fdcafb9ce
proposals.title: Name the boot by its session identifier in the network generation
proposals.requirement_mapping: A network generation must identify the actual boot, not mutable wall-clock-derived boottime.
proposals.evidence: Baseline: 31 failures from missing session-ID implementation and changed fake command expectations. Candidate uses bounded sysctl boot-session UUID, rejects malformed output and binds generations; source and hosted grammar checks reviewed.

proposals.head: 1c9ece85300b9315f1cd13db2dffdd5341db7c74
proposals.title: Start a fully stopped fleet on service-manager evidence (opt-in)
proposals.requirement_mapping: Distinguish a truly stopped fleet from API reset while guest runtime jobs survive.
proposals.evidence: Independent candidate proof: 3 tests failed because arbitrary vendor prefix/API labels were accepted and nonexistent jobs falsely established absence. Supplement constrains fixed Apple labels at parser AND direct runtime boundary; retained-peer proof uses the same helper. Upstream Plugin.getLaunchdLabel hardcodes prefix in supported tags.

proposals.head: 188f32ebd07dbb9cd9f6aff83d21a26c2cc4d3bd
proposals.title: Test the installer statefully and reach its unreached checks
proposals.requirement_mapping: Meaningful install/recovery sequence coverage
proposals.evidence: Stateful machine models filesystem/tool state, operator pause and holder union; disk fsync deliberately mocked, fake launchd. Passing model sequences do not establish native durability.

proposals.head: 2a3481f137da8896b7d2e93f89bdca7d145d5b57
proposals.title: Reword the hard-bounds row and ask for the packet from outside
proposals.requirement_mapping: Truthful any-source authority and packet acceptance
proposals.evidence: Updates hard-bound wording to declared+admitted, requires outside-source packet evidence on explicit any-source profile rather than upgrading generic proof. No host instance acceptance is invented.

proposals.head: 2a179e24385cc6b4766507179ef46413153d6196
proposals.title: Keep the predecessor when a failed upgrade is recovered
proposals.requirement_mapping: Failed upgrade recovery retains prior rollback target
proposals.evidence: Recovery preserves full replaced receipt including one predecessor; successful installs cap nested history, bounded journal beforehold. Candidate tests interrupted upgrade/recovery and historical formats.

proposals.head: 580509dada0a666c417a8edc4b5b2b1d3c9ec972
proposals.title: Check the predecessor's own jobs before a rollback changes anything
proposals.requirement_mapping: No foreign predecessor job clobber during rollback
proposals.evidence: Prior-only file/label check precedes hold/journal/tool writes; resume accepts only its own predecessor bytes. Closing-write repeat works; supplemental fe1d750 additionally verifies current restored state before holdrelease.

proposals.head: d1bb980f3528c5fe13f644a3efcfed1abaed3a46
proposals.title: Refuse a job interval below the launchd throttle it is rendered with
proposals.requirement_mapping: Honor actual scheduler floor in bounded timing
proposals.evidence: Intervals below fixed10 throttle refused; single constant feeds parser and renderer. Existing Monit template throttle30 remains not representable, so no full launcher byte-parity claim. Recovery over older invalid failed release reads only boundaries.

proposals.head: 53071922bd63a1b33c54480a1507c09fdf202a36
proposals.title: Let a workload's contract state its own start bound
proposals.requirement_mapping: Keep heavy workload start budgets separate while respecting the actual supervision contract.
proposals.evidence: Per-workload start bound precedence, strict bounds, defaults and subprocess timeout covered by candidate tests. Independent source review shows no end-to-end action deadline; parent is correcting instance conformance reporting. Independent 40/120-second call budgets yielded42.5/122.5-second whole actions; whole-action gaps now remain explicitly unsupported.

proposals.head: 3d2f9369fed3cea41a82658dccc96cb0ce469273
proposals.title: Hold a workload whose restart budget is spent
proposals.requirement_mapping: Repeated failed recovery must hold only the affected service, persist through restart, and not unpause or stop the fleet.
proposals.evidence: Inspected durable budget reservation before start, monotonic-compatible wall-time record validation, corruption/clock reversal conservatism, operation lock and service hold tests. Supplemental fixture test now proves a separately named intent cannot bypass operator pause with or without a budget.

proposals.head: e4bd4ae830ba61cff0a6bd2483119efaab548661
proposals.title: Let the supervisor start the vendor runtime where settings opt in
proposals.requirement_mapping: A separately enrolled single owner may start vendor runtime in the user GUI context before recovery; preserve runtime data.
proposals.evidence: Inspected root/env validation, executable/plist identity, fresh stopped evidence before vendor start, no shell use and post-start checks. Candidate tests exercise command/environment/deadline failures. Fixed-label amendment also closes alternate label loophole when runtime_start omitted.

proposals.head: cf700adff5582b7e40c0dbe3434ee8d148e5c9ef
proposals.title: Read the runtime owner's intent and admissions as protected files
proposals.requirement_mapping: Operator pause, holds and approved admissions must be authoritative, protected, bounded and share recovery locking.
proposals.evidence: Independent candidate proofs: 2 failed. A recovery lock on state_dir used a different private unpaused intent file while authoritative intent was paused; UnsafeState escaped CLI redaction. Supplement binds intent exactly to state_dir/intent.json and redacts UnsafeState. Existing file-type/owner/mode/hardlink/no-follow checks retained.

proposals.head: 09b3d2bc733c2c26a29a452369b30a422a333fb6
proposals.title: Accept the account's user/<uid> domain as network helper domain
proposals.requirement_mapping: Apple API registered in user/<uid> context must be readable without inventing gui/<uid> identity.
proposals.evidence: Source ServiceManager domain grammar confirms own-user, gui and system variants. Candidate closed parser rejects another UID and cross-domain mismatch; bounded fixture tests pass.

proposals.head: e5fda3a29fd074d9ff48500b829a84447edcaf86
proposals.title: Refuse at enrollment what the settings loader would not read back
proposals.requirement_mapping: Captured enrollment must reload exactly and fail before producing unusable/potentially dangerous contracts.
proposals.evidence: Reviewed pre-enrollment type checks, stored size validation, roundtrip digests and invalid volume types. Candidate tests cover all declared optional members and former unloadable definitions.

proposals.head: 2e5b77a528352b48cdd2c064d921e82348a79b14
proposals.title: Check a recipe's environment file and look up its init image
proposals.requirement_mapping: No inherited host environment/secret value ambiguity and no unreviewed init-image fetch during provision.
proposals.evidence: Vendor Parser env-file behavior and candidate tests verify literal key=value lines, reject inherited bare keys, and inspect the additional init image before mutation.

proposals.head: 5609523c149ba8a23f54693d83c194b8093ac2bf
proposals.title: Pass over a peer's memory-backed mount in the single-writer check
proposals.requirement_mapping: A peer tmpfs does not write a host bind, but unknown runtime/mount kinds cannot bypass single-writer checks.
proposals.evidence: Reviewed exact native handler+mount-kind recognition; malformed/type-confusion tests and writable-peer controls pass. Updated interaction test uses independently proven stopped peer instead of trusting API state.

proposals.head: 404378c40b2f126d433c7c055bf575d330c70ba6
proposals.title: Let the runtime settings state the bound of one complete read
proposals.requirement_mapping: One finite observation pass includes all subprocess/ACL reads without per-call deadline multiplication.
proposals.evidence: Candidate tests exercise accumulated deadlines, malformed bounds, remaining-time propagation and start/provision callers. Runtime read deadline independent from vendor start is appropriate.

proposals.head: 1a64843eb23c333a43b8a44eb074ceb05ff53bbd
proposals.title: Print what the retained supervisor cannot honour of an instance
proposals.requirement_mapping: Explicit incomplete supervision
proposals.evidence: Command reports actual unsupported pointers without values or silently translating semantics; all common input and contract gates remain active.

proposals.head: d383640152cdb22225d3f1fb0c59297b136fa00d
proposals.title: Read a contract file only from inside the data directory
proposals.requirement_mapping: Read-only contract containment
proposals.evidence: Resolved directory containment blocks static symlink escape before content read; descriptor and content hash checks retained. Layout precheck is not atomic protection against concurrent parent replacement and does not claim to be.

proposals.head: c9256444fea995e30e6e3e24ca24b3f6d7649032
proposals.title: Hold a PF anchor to what the tool and the kernel can take
proposals.requirement_mapping: Usable pinned PF anchor length
proposals.evidence: Full argument max63 narrows kernel-only component assumption; existing anchor is inside bound. Hosted CI notes corroborate tool63-byte limit; fresh local kernel acceptance was not run.

proposals.head: 5d0285783b19929dab57b6e15fee0cd705dd580f
proposals.title: Tell a pfctl listing refused for a notice from one that failed
proposals.requirement_mapping: Unknown PF listings stay failures without leaking raw stderr
proposals.evidence: Backend reserved76 carries only count; owner closes vocabulary and does not treat warning-only reads as emptiness. Arbitrary stderr not exposed. Parser-only pfctl warning exempt, not assumed harmless for live reads.

proposals.head: c18b14887653d6c676c964f7d9a924aa81856c5e
proposals.title: Gate the UDP return pair on a verified translation order
proposals.requirement_mapping: HA static-port NAT ordering preserving Broadlink first packet
proposals.evidence: Readable installed source already checks fixed stock hook order and sibling translations; candidate explicit verified option gates activation/readiness but does not flush global state or retire merely for foreign-order uncertainty. Live hook form and packet path unverified.

proposals.head: 13b81402c49f6f3a85f8d1d674bc8d93552d74b2
proposals.title: Let an installation keep host paths without runtime evidence
proposals.requirement_mapping: Retain structural host path during observation timeout
proposals.evidence: Only exact admitted alreadyloaded host targets, held PF reference and current fullport listener inventory qualify; only timeout/previouslyvalid stale evidence, never changed generation/identity or unavailable error; no new activation/reference. Listener alone is residual availability policy, not identity proof. Default retire retained. Exact-head3.12 CI cancelled, must pass combined final revision.

proposals.head: dcc7c4b32c5234ff8e7c9e5d3ce63f6a38e22125
proposals.title: Let a discovery policy state its own miss tolerance
proposals.requirement_mapping: Needed to bind each policy miss threshold into its own digest and express the installed direction-specific behavior. Authoritative instance-to-owner rendering is root review work.
proposals.evidence: Needed to bind each policy miss threshold into its own digest and express the installed direction-specific behavior. Authoritative instance-to-owner rendering is root review work.

proposals.head: d846b70eea7653c9e74b126173c5c238b0677124
proposals.title: Renew a registration beside the client it replaces, as an option
proposals.requirement_mapping: Retain as opt-in candidate only; overlap can maintain truthful present only when a current predecessor/successor actually confirms. No native duplicate-registration/cache-continuity acceptance; not automatically enabled for the host.
proposals.evidence: Retain as opt-in candidate only; overlap can maintain truthful present only when a current predecessor/successor actually confirms. No native duplicate-registration/cache-continuity acceptance; not automatically enabled for the host.

proposals.head: f839f99332995e5c899ca75ec21841cf99d926c0
proposals.title: Let a scan pass whose read did not complete count as a miss
proposals.requirement_mapping: Retain bounded opt-in failure forms with visible tolerated_failure and unchanged source timestamp. Never infer this is inward legacy behavior. Amended cross-type failure path to discard an explicitly unusable answer even beside unfinished sibling reads.
proposals.evidence: Retain bounded opt-in failure forms with visible tolerated_failure and unchanged source timestamp. Never infer this is inward legacy behavior. Amended cross-type failure path to discard an explicitly unusable answer even beside unfinished sibling reads.

proposals.head: c90e2d95a57d0fbc470f26bc3328e9e16dc18d13
proposals.title: Refuse credential keys that a capital inside the word used to hide
proposals.requirement_mapping: Credential and conformance interaction
proposals.evidence: Wider refusing guard correctly detects irregular capitals. Integrated separate narrow relaxation guard prevents widening unexamined subtrees; regression tests verify replyToKen containing undeclared address is refused.

proposals.head: 795f59939788e78e3ca0f4f45e984fdeb7b7b0dd
proposals.title: Give the macOS test job time for the suite the open changes add
proposals.requirement_mapping: Complete macOS CI
proposals.evidence: Only test-job timeout changes15to45minutes; matrix, coverage, action pins and dependency locks unchanged. Previous combined hosted run exceeded15minutes in allthreePythonjobs.
